pk.context: 160 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: white to off-white, oblong soft gelatin capsule

tell: Its major metabolite, N-desmethyl enzalutamide, has similar in vitro activity to the parent drug.

clues.text: A high-fat meal has no clinically meaningful effect on exposure. It is 97% to 98% bound to plasma proteins, and hepatic metabolism is its main elimination route.
Molecular weight 464.44. The crystalline solid is non-hygroscopic and practically insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA as 40 mg capsules, and as 40 mg and 80 mg tablets. Taken once daily.
No boxed warning, and no contraindications. Musculoskeletal pain and fatigue are the most common reactions, at 10% or more.
Castration-resistant prostate cancer, metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer, and non-metastatic castration-sensitive cancer with high-risk biochemical recurrence.
Competitively blocks androgen binding to the androgen receptor, which stops its nuclear translocation and its interaction with DNA.
The generic name begins with E and has twelve letters.
